original.target_description: Original full text not acquired; target test not independently verified.

replication.target_description: Study 1, Stanford participant-pool sample: unadjusted OLS regression of dictator-game performance on subjective SES.

n.quote: A total sample of N = 300 participants completed both the short online survey and the laboratory session assessing dictator game performance.
n.sample_role: Participants with complete predictor and outcome data in the main unadjusted OLS test.
n.exclusions: Only complete questionnaires without missing predictor/outcome data were analyzed; no further exclusions in the main analysis (p. 9). The 51 participants disbelieving pairing were excluded only in a separate sensitivity analysis.

reported_success.quote: In two high-powered and preregistered replication studies, we did not find evidence in support of the relationship between social class and prosocial behavior reported by Piff et al. (2010).

notes: Replication title, authors and DOI verified in cached pre-proof. Locator p. 13 identifies the main unadjusted test; adjusted and sensitivity estimates were not substituted. Original acquisition failed; original statistics summarized by replication authors were not substituted for independent original-paper extraction.
